positive_observations: Clear adult human silhouette with readable head, torso, two arms and two legs; no visible extra limbs in inspected keys.
Primary identity is broadly retained: dark hair with silver forelock, beard, burgundy scarf, blue-gray and copper armor.
Right-handed hammer grip is visually continuous in inspected attack keys; no obvious detached or floating weapon.
96px and128px contact previews retain a readable face and hammer silhouette.

issues.observation: Hammer overlaps the near-side face; defense_02 covers the near eye and about half of the face, reducing identity readability.

Large pose jumps between overhead swing and impact, then low followthrough and recovery. The contact sheet suggests possible stepped timing; native 3D continuity does not prove the illustrated eight-key clip is smooth.
issues.uncertainty: This inspection viewed static contact and individual frames, not real-time playback.

issues.observation: Standing proportions appear closer to roughly four heads than exactly3.5; no exact anatomical landmark measurement was performed on painted sprites.
Shoulder trim, skirt plates and gripping-hand contour show small redrawing differences. Not diagnosed as broken anatomy, but pixel identity is not constant.

scope_note: The native mesh and bone technical audit is separate from this painted-output visual assessment.
